name: Customer account admin
segment: Small businesses (3-50 staff) on a paid plan with 3 or more seats
context: Owner, office manager or finance lead who signed or inherited the contract; sets Ledgerly up alongside their normal job; usually the only person in the business who knows how the books are kept

name: Customer team member
segment: Staff at the same accounts who create, approve or send invoices
context: Joins after the admin invites them; invoiced before in spreadsheets, a word processor or a previous tool; has no say in set-up decisions

name: External accountant or bookkeeper
segment: Accounts whose books are kept by an outside firm (share of cohort unknown; see EVD-2026-0018)
context: Serves many small clients; is not a Ledgerly customer; is asked to confirm tax-rate and account mapping without access to the product

name: Onboarding specialist
context: Runs 45-minute set-up sessions for accounts that qualify under the onboarding tier policy; enables the customer journey but is not its primary actor
